candidates.description: This vector represents common prefixes and combining forms used in word formation.
This feature vector activates on terms related to medicine, pharmaceuticals, and chemistry.
This feature vector represents terms associated with cannabis, marijuana, and related cannabinoids.
This vector represents adjectives and qualifiers relating to difficulty, possibility, and variation in both English and French.
This vector represents brain and mind-related medical and scientific terminology.
This vector is related to nominal and adverbial suffixes used to form nouns and adverbs, particularly in Romance languages.
This feature vector activates on terms related to cannabis, hemp, and cannabinoids alongside various multilingual and fragmentary word pieces.
This vector activates on words and terms related to French loanwords, socio-cultural concepts, or specific administrative and medical jargon.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to words and subwords related to actions, activity, and activation.
Tokens ending with or containing adjectival suffixes related to condition or state.
